in_hebrew.name: גולדה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גולדה מקורו בעברית, והוא קשור לתיאורים של נשים כהות בעולם העברי, כמו גם לתפיסת האשה כגולה (נשיאה) וגולה (נשים כהות). השם גולדה נמצא בשימוש בעולם העברי, לרוב בצורות ובדימויים שונים, והוא נחשב לשם נשים מקובל.

in_greek.name: Γολδα
in_greek.long_meaning: ο τίτλος Γολδα起源 από το Εβραϊκό και υποδηλώνει μια γυναίκα με σκούρο χρώμα, παρόμοια με τηλελεγαντική περιγραφή των γυναικών με σκούρο χρώμα στο Εβραϊκό. Η λέξη Γολδα χρησιμοποιείται στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και η σημασία της είναι ότι έχει σκούρο χρώμα.

in_latin.name: Golda
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Golda originem habet ex lingua Hebraica et significat mulierem nigricam. In Ecclesia ab initio, nomen huius modi erat in usu, cum mulieres nigricantes in mundo antiquo fuerunt, quae erant in servitute. Nomen Golda adhuc in usu est in variis formis et figuris, et est nomen mulierum in usu.

in_english.name: Golda
in_english.long_meaning: The name Golda originates from Hebrew and means a black woman or a dark-skinned woman. In the early Christian church, names of this type were in use, as black women in the ancient world were often in servitude. The name Golda is still in use today in various forms and figures, and it is a name for women in use. It is also associated with qualities such as strength, resilience, and beauty. In Christian tradition, the name Golda is seen as a symbol of the beauty and strength of women in the faith.

data.cultural_impact: Golda was the first woman to be elected Prime Minister of Israel in 1969, breaking the glass ceiling for women in politics. She played a significant role in the founding and development of the State of Israel and was a respected international leader. Her name has become synonymous with strength, resilience, and determination in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Golda can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual wealth and abundance that comes from a deep and meaningful relationship with God. Golda's life and legacy serve as a reminder to seek the riches and treasures that come from a life well-lived, rooted in faith, hope, and love.
